g.text: PATTERN CHOICES: each shape sets the technology, cost, hosting model and operating model. The same truth controls apply to every shape.
SOLUTION SHAPES: each shape implements the same contracts

text.tspan: A person admits each semantic claim and reviews each contradiction.
Each record carries its source, and each assembled figure carries its lineage.
Rules define which claims the system can record and release.
Owning systems serve current operational facts through governed queries.
Every registered external answer uses one governed release path after its release record is saved.
Approval waits and effect settlement records survive process loss.
Legend. The dark card shows the logical architecture. Each light card shows one solution shape. Green marks local knowledge services. Blue-grey marks
managed operational services. The dashed card allows further mappings. The red rule marks controls shared by every shape. Colours group design roles.
an open-format document corpus under version control, an
embedded vector and lexical index, an open embedding model,
a hosted general orchestrator behind a substitution seam
Pattern B: managed search and warehouse
a cloud search service for retrieval, a columnar warehouse for
operational federation, a serverless workflow engine, a model
registry, a catalogue carrying lineage and policy
platform search over governed shares, in-platform model serving,
a durable function runtime, and the platform's own registry and
the knowledge plane held close, the operational plane reached live
through governed federation, and the reasoning tier substitutable
an adopter can map the contracts to another technology estate
